answer.answer: Only one Mediterranean pair meets the same-method, <50 km, <1 year criteria — Caldwell et al. 2019 and Caldwell et al. 2020 (both Manta net, ~15 km apart, sampled ~11 months apart). Their median factor is 0.498088/0.064088 ≈ 7.77.
